usage: generate_urdf.py [-h] [--export EXPORT] [--config CONFIG] [--out OUT]

Generate FaceHugger URDF from Fusion export

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --export EXPORT  Path to fusion_export.json (default: <REPO>/code/simulation/generated/fusion_export.json)
  --config CONFIG  Path to facehugger_config.yaml (default: <REPO>/code/simulation/facehugger_config.yaml)
  --out OUT        Output URDF path (default: <REPO>/code/simulation/generated/facehugger.urdf)
